profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Designer at Kusari
profile.summary:
I’m a fullstack engineer and designer with a background in UX, frontend development, backend development, and cloud infrastructure. I thrive in fast-paced environments where I can jump between designing interfaces, writing APIs, and optimizing databases—all while keeping things running in production. Right now, I’m working on securing the software supply chain. 

I’ve worn a lot of hats over the years. I love solving problems at the intersection of design and engineering—whether it’s improving accessibility in large enterprise apps, building design systems, or optimizing cloud infrastructure. I move fast, ship often, and enjoy working in agile teams that care about both user experience and technical excellence.  

Outside of tech, I have way too many hobbies, including sewing, painting, archery, and historical European martial arts. I also make a pretty sweet charcuterie board.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
As a full-stack engineer and designer at a small startup, I contribute to the development of a risk-ops-as-a-service platform focused on multi-chain risk management, financial modeling, and real-time monitoring.

- Design multiple web applications, marketing site, and branding materials.
- Frontend development in React, Remix, and NextJS.
- API development using Node and AWS Lambda.
- Manage a PostgreSQL Timescale database.
- Manage and deploy AWS and Google cloud infrastructure.
- Monitor applications with Grafana and Cloudwatch alarms.
- Develop automated deployment pipelines using Github Actions.
- Collaborate within an agile development team.
- Deploy to production multiple times a day.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · React.js · PostgreSQL · Node.js

positions.title: Graphic Design Intern
positions.description: A wide variety graphic design projects including portions of larger projects, such logo design, interior and exterior design work, and printed pieces.
